convert_file.description: Convert a file to another format: for example a Word document to PDF, a PNG to JPG, or a video to MP4. The converted file is saved so later steps can email, upload, or store it.
convert_file.display_str_template: Convert a file to {1} with CloudConvert.
convert_file.name: convert_file

parameters.description: The file to convert: upload one, pick a file from an earlier step, or paste a public file URL.

parameters.description: The format to convert into, for example 'pdf', 'docx', 'jpg' or 'mp4'.
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.description: Optional. The format the file is already in. CloudConvert detects this on its own; set it only when the file has a missing or misleading extension.
parameters.name: input_format

parameters.description: Optional. The name to save the converted file under. Defaults to the original name with the new extension.
parameters.name: filename
